description: This module manages database backups on Scaleway account https://developer.scaleway.com.

parameters.name: api_timeout
parameters.description: HTTP timeout to Scaleway API in seconds. Default: 30

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: Scaleway OAuth token. This is required if profile is not specified.

parameters.name: database_name
parameters.description: Name used to identify the database. Required for present and restored states. Ignored when state=absent or state=exported.

parameters.name: expires_at
parameters.description: Expiration datetime of the database backup (ISO 8601 format). Ignored when state=absent, state=exported or state=restored.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID used to identify the database backup. Required for absent, exported and restored states.

parameters.name: instance_id
parameters.description: UUID of the instance associated to the database backup. Required for present and restored states. Ignored when state=absent or state=exported.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name used to identify the database backup. Required for present state. Ignored when state=absent, state=exported or state=restored.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: The config profile in config file to load the Scaleway OAuth token from, use instead of api_token. It is also possible to set SCW_PROFILE to use a SCW CLI config profile.

parameters.name: query_parameters
parameters.description: List of parameters passed to the query string. Default: {}

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Scaleway region to use (for example fr-par). Choices: "fr-par" "nl-ams" "pl-waw"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Indicate desired state of the database backup. present creates a backup. absent deletes the backup. exported creates a download link for the backup. restored restores the backup to a new database. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent" "exported" "restored"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Validate SSL certs of the Scaleway API. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Wait for the instance to reach its desired state before returning. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: wait_sleep_time
parameters.description: Time to wait before every attempt to check the state of the backup. Default: 3

parameters.name: wait_timeout
parameters.description: Time to wait for the backup to reach the expected state. Default: 300

examples:
- name: Create a backup
  community.general.scaleway_database_backup:
    name: 'my_backup'
    state: present
    region: 'fr-par'
    database_name: 'my-database'
    instance_id: '50968a80-2909-4e5c-b1af-a2e19860dddb'

- name: Export a backup
  community.general.scaleway_database_backup:
    id: '6ef1125a-037e-494f-a911-6d9c49a51691'
    state: exported
    region: 'fr-par'

- name: Restore a backup
  community.general.scaleway_database_backup:
    id: '6ef1125a-037e-494f-a911-6d9c49a51691'
    state: restored
    region: 'fr-par'
    database_name: 'my-new-database'
    instance_id: '50968a80-2909-4e5c-b1af-a2e19860dddb'

- name: Remove a backup
  community.general.scaleway_database_backup:
    id: '6ef1125a-037e-494f-a911-6d9c49a51691'
    state: absent
    region: 'fr-par'

return_values.name: metadata
return_values.description: Backup metadata. Returned: when state=present, state=exported, or state=restored Sample: {"metadata": {"created_at": "2020-08-06T12:42:05.631049Z", "database_name": "my-database", "download_url": null, "download_url_expires_at": null, "expires_at": null, "id": "a15297bd-0c4a-4b4f-8fbb-b36a35b7eb07", "instance_id": "617be32e-6497-4ed7-b4c7-0ee5a81edf49", "instance_name": "my-instance", "name": "backup_name", "region": "fr-par", "size": 600000, "status": "ready", "updated_at": "2020-08-06T12:42:10.581649Z"}}
